title: A single accepted advisory skips every build and Worker verification job in CI
root_cause: Security Checks runs `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level high` with no exemption for the formally accepted sharp risk (BA-0044); build + cloudflare-build both `needs: [test, security]`
sink: Production Build, Cloudflare Worker Build and Lighthouse all skipped
reproduction: gh run view 30513673331: Security Checks failure; Production Build skipped; Cloudflare Worker Build skipped; Lighthouse skipped
focused_verification: Confirmed against runs 30513673331 (1301734f) and 30512740454 (6d9a3ac9) - both red on npm audit only
production_impact: No build or Worker verification has run in CI since the advisory appeared, so the RTA-0001 deploy breakage was invisible to CI
deployment_requirement: Owner must decide CI advisory policy
deferred_reason: Deciding which advisories CI may tolerate is a security-policy call; changing it unilaterally would read as weakening a gate
owner_decision: Express the accepted sharp exception in CI (or decouple build jobs from the advisory gate) so new advisories still fail but accepted ones do not blind the pipeline
notes: postcss bump in 46c0d4ed removed 2 of the 5 advisories but does NOT turn this green - the sharp set remains

title: push-reminders cron route has no scheduler; deadline reminders cannot fire
root_cause: BA-0016 removed the GitHub Actions schedule trigger (correctly - it was an unreconciled fourth scheduler whose secrets were unset) but the route was never adopted into the Cloudflare triggers, which carry only the three cleanup expressions
reproduction: wrangler.jsonc production triggers.crons = 3 cleanup expressions only; CRON_ROUTE_BY_EXPRESSION maps the same 3; gh run list --workflow=push-reminders-cron.yml: 0 successes in last 300 runs, all failures, schedule trigger now removed
fix_commit: d7036029 (gap pinned as a test invariant; not enabled)
production_impact: Push/deadline reminder notifications do not fire in production. The route's own batch cap documents a 10-minute cadence it no longer has for catch-up after truncation
deferred_reason: Wiring a trigger resumes real push delivery to real users; audit brief §2.4 puts scheduled-trigger changes outside a code-only pass
owner_decision: Add '*/10 * * * *' -> /api/cron/push-reminders to CRON_ROUTE_BY_EXPRESSION and wrangler.jsonc production triggers
notes: Encoded as an explicit KNOWN_UNSCHEDULED exception carrying its reason, so any NEW cron-authenticated route added without an owner fails the suite

title: Password-reset and email-verify tokens were double-spendable under a race
root_cause: Consuming UPDATE did not check the affected row count; PostgREST reports a zero-row UPDATE as success (error: null), so the loser of a race proceeded to the privileged write
reproduction: Both zero-row cases failed 'expected 200 to be 400' against the old code, i.e. the routes performed the privileged write for the loser
focused_verification: 4 new tests pass; tests/api/auth 11 files / 40 tests pass
production_impact: A single-use recovery token could be spent twice
notes: Carried from 2026-07-22 as BA-0006 status `candidate`; confirmed in both routes and closed. passwordReset.test.ts fixture updated (contract change, assertion unchanged)

title: WebAuthn RP ID and expected origin failed OPEN to client-controlled headers
root_cause: Both resolvers fell back to the request's own Host/Origin when the env anchor was missing, making the origin check compare an attacker-supplied value against itself
reproduction: Static: both resolvers returned header-derived values with the env unset. Latency of exploit depends on process.env being empty, which BA-0017 proves is possible on Workers
full_verification: 146 files / 1285 tests pass; typecheck + typecheck:cloudflare exit 0
production_impact: Latent, not live - production sets both anchors. Becomes live under a BA-0017-style empty process.env isolate
notes: Carried from 2026-07-22 as BA-0003 status `validated`, never fixed. Whitespace-only now treated as missing

title: HIBP breach lookup was unbounded and could hang signup and password reset
root_cause: fetch had no timeout and no abort signal, so the documented fail-open covered a dependency that FAILS but not one that HANGS
reproduction: With the signal removed the hang test dies with 'Test timed out in 10000ms', reproducing the stall rather than asserting a shape
production_impact: A hanging third party could stall account creation and password reset until the platform killed the request
notes: Found by inventorying every outbound host and checking each caller for a timeout/abort path - this was the one with neither in front of account creation

title: postcss pinned to a version affected by two high advisories
root_cause: An overrides.next.postcss entry (17b1fe11) pinned 8.5.10; the advisories (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849) are fixed in 8.5.18. npm's proposed remedy was a next@14 major DOWNGRADE, so the 2026-07-22 audit filed it as unreachable and moved on
reproduction: npm audit reported 5 high; postcss accounted for 2
regression_test: none added (advisory count is asserted by no test)
focused_verification: postcss resolves 8.5.25; npm audit 5 high -> 4 high; Sharp gate exit 0; gate self-tests 27/27
full_verification: 147 files / 1289 tests pass; npm run build compiled; CSS output verified non-empty (250 KB, MQ tokens, Tailwind utilities, autoprefixer output)
production_impact: Build-time only; not reachable at runtime
notes: Remaining 4 advisories are one root cause: sharp/libvips via Next's OPTIONAL image dependency, governed by the reachability gate

title: Password reset does not revoke the user's other sessions
root_cause: Password *change* revokes via auth.signOut({scope:'others'}) (BA-0005) but reset runs unauthenticated, and admin.signOut in @supabase/auth-js 2.104.1 requires the user's JWT which that path never has
reproduction: Static: no revocation call in the reset path; confirmed admin API surface offers only signOut(jwt, scope)
production_impact: An attacker's session survives the recovery that was meant to evict it - and reset is the mechanism used precisely when compromise is suspected
deferred_reason: Closing it requires a SECURITY DEFINER function over auth.refresh_tokens (a migration) or a GoTrue-level change; out of scope for a code-only pass and migrations must not be applied to production in this audit
owner_decision: Add a definer function to revoke refresh tokens by user id, or adopt a GoTrue version exposing admin logout by user id
notes: BA-0005 was marked fixed_targeted for the change path only; this is the residual and it is the more security-relevant of the two

title: Webmanifest served a doubled Content-Type
root_cause: public/_headers declared Content-Type for /manifest.webmanifest twice - an exact-path rule and a /*.webmanifest glob - and Cloudflare applies every matching rule and appends
reproduction: Verified live: curl -sSI https://www.syllabus-sync.app/manifest.webmanifest returns the comma-joined value
focused_verification: 8 tests pass; reintroducing the rule fails with 'set by 2 rules'
production_impact: A comma-joined Content-Type is not a valid media type; a browser may reject it, costing PWA installability
deployment_requirement: Deploy required - _headers ships with the assets
notes: Root cause for the 2026-07-29 'doubled Content-Type, root cause unidentified' follow-up. Cannot be confirmed live until deployed

title: Eleven SECURITY DEFINER functions have no pinned search_path
root_cause: Their current definitions omit SET search_path, and the migration chain contains no ALTER FUNCTION ... SET search_path anywhere to supply it later
sink: definer-privileged execution with a mutable resolution path
affected_files: supabase/migrations (add_sample_class_times, handle_new_user_profile, on_deadline_completed, protect_profile_fields, handle_new_user_gamification, soft_delete, purge_deleted_records, refresh_analytics_views, seed_demo_events, audit_trigger, cleanup_expired_webauthn_challenges)
reproduction: Static over the full ordered chain, keeping only each function's LAST definition; verified no ALTER FUNCTION ... SET search_path exists in any migration
production_impact: Defence-in-depth. Exploitation needs CREATE on a schema earlier in the resolution path, which Supabase revokes from PUBLIC by default - so not demonstrated live
deployment_requirement: Confirm against the live catalogue then pin
deferred_reason: Requires a migration; live catalogue state was not queried in this pass, and several are trigger functions where a bad pin changes behaviour
owner_decision: Pin search_path on each; several are triggers (handle_new_user_profile
column23: protect_profile_fields) which is the classic hijack shape
column25: Violates the repo's own stated rule that SECURITY DEFINER functions must pin search_path

root_cause: Migrations register pg_cron jobs at '0 3 * * *' and '10 3 * * *' - the exact expressions Cloudflare uses for /api/auth/email/cleanup and /api/auth/password/cleanup
reproduction: Static: cron.schedule expressions compared against wrangler.jsonc production triggers
production_impact: Low - both sides issue idempotent DELETEs of expired rows. But a green Cloudflare cron is not evidence the cleanup ran, and the two contend at the same minute
deployment_requirement: Confirm pg_cron is installed on the live project
deferred_reason: Requires a read-only live catalogue query that was not performed; if pg_cron is absent the finding is moot
owner_decision: Unschedule the two duplicated pg_cron jobs or drop the Cloudflare triggers; keep cleanup-webauthn-challenges (pg_cron only)
notes: Carried from 2026-07-22 as BA-0011 status `validated`. cleanup-webauthn-challenges at */15 is NOT duplicated

title: npm run check omits the deploy-blocking gates
root_cause: `check` runs secrets -> cloudflare-runtime -> format -> typecheck x2 -> lint -> test -> build, but not security:sharp:audit-exception or check:worker-size
sink: green check with a broken deploy path
reproduction: Baseline: npm run check exit 0 while check-sharp-risk.mjs audit-exception exited 1

title: .prettierignore excludes all security source from the formatting gate
root_cause: A bare `security` pattern matches any path segment of that name, so lib/security/, tests/security/, app/api/security/ and docs/security/ are all exempt
reproduction: npx prettier --check lib/security/password-breach.ts passes despite the file using double quotes where the repo uses single
production_impact: None directly. But the most security-sensitive directory is the one the formatting gate cannot see, and style drift there goes unreviewed
review_expiry: Scope the pattern (e.g. docs/security) rather than leaving it bare
column23: Deliberately NOT fixed: narrowing it would reformat many files at once, which the brief forbids. Explains the double/single quote split in lib/security/

title: Twenty-one API routes authenticate inline instead of via the mandated guard
root_cause: Routes call supabase.auth.getUser() directly rather than wrapping in requireAuth / requireAuthWithRateLimit / withApiGuard as AGENT.md §1 requires
reproduction: Generated from source: 16 requireAuthWithRateLimit, 5 requireAuth, 21 inline getUser(), 26 none (public allowlist or page routes)
production_impact: Layer-2 CSRF and rate-limit wrapping is skipped; edge middleware still performs CSRF origin validation, so this is defence-in-depth not an open hole. Most carry a named limiter already
review_expiry: Migrate to the guard wrappers incrementally; several already call a limiter manually
column23: None of the 26 'no guard' routes is a genuine gap - all are intentionally unauthenticated endpoints or page routes

title: Two parallel passkey stacks with divergent middleware posture
root_cause: /api/auth/passkey/* is inside the `/api/auth/` public allowlist so it is exempt from BOTH deny-by-default and the middleware AAL2 gate; /api/webauthn/register/* is not on the allowlist and gets both
reproduction: Static: the AAL gate condition is `isProtectedRoute || isAuthRoute || (isApiRoute && !isPublicApi)`, and /api/auth/ matches isPublicApiPath
production_impact: Passkey enrolment via the /api/auth/passkey/* stack does not require AAL2. Both stacks still verify the session inline
review_expiry: Consolidate onto one stack; until then decide whether passkey enrolment must require AAL2
column23: Confirms the second half of BA-0004 (status `candidate`). lib/constants/config.ts references both stacks

title: Dev-only pin editor ships fs into the Worker bundle
root_cause: app/api/maps/dev-pin/route.ts statically imports node:fs and sets runtime='nodejs' for a feature guarded by NODE_ENV !== 'development'
reproduction: Static: guard returns 403 before touching fs, so unreachable in production, but the module is still bundled
production_impact: None - fails closed. Costs Worker bundle size, which is 6791 KiB gzip against a near-ceiling budget, and adds needless attack surface
review_expiry: Exclude dev-only routes from production builds
column23: Guard itself is correct - checked and it returns 403 before any fs call

production_impact: None today - it 308s to www correctly. Becomes an outage the moment Vercel is decommissioned

title: Live email-sending endpoint with zero callers
root_cause: /api/auth/email/send-verification exists, is on the /api/auth/ public allowlist, and sends mail — but nothing calls it. lib/constants/config.ts declares EMAIL_SEND_VERIFICATION and that constant is itself never referenced
reproduction: grep across app/ components/ features/ lib/ tests/ finds no caller; EMAIL_SEND_VERIFICATION appears only at its own declaration

title: session-termination.ts is dead code presented as a security control
root_cause: All five exported functions have ZERO call sites outside their own module and the lib/security/index.ts barrel, yet the module is re-exported from that barrel and backed by a real user_sessions table created in 20260214001000_align_code_db_objects.sql
sink: user_sessions table that nothing ever populates
reproduction: Per-function grep: terminateAllSessions, terminateOtherSessions, terminateSession, recordSession, getUserSessions all 0 external call sites. No code outside this module reads or writes user_sessions
production_impact: No direct impact - it simply never runs. The risk is misreading: it appears in the security barrel and has a real table, so a reader or auditor can credit session termination as implemented when it is not, and a future change could call it believing it works
review_expiry: Delete the module and the table, or wire it up; do not leave it exported from the security barrel
column23: BA-0005's fix comment already noted this; now quantified with call-site counts. Real revocation is done by auth.signOut({scope:'others'}) in app/api/auth/password/route.ts

title: Four pages declare page-level 'use client', losing metadata
root_cause: 'use client' at page scope prevents a Next.js page from exporting metadata, which is the exact anti-pattern AGENT.md/CLAUDE.md record as 'already fixed once here, don't regress it'
sink: no metadata emitted for these routes
reproduction: Static: each file begins with 'use client' and exports neither metadata nor generateMetadata (0 matches). 7 of 23 pages export no metadata overall
production_impact: No security impact. These four routes emit no title/description, affecting browser tab titles and link sharing; /manage-profiles is a real app surface. app/settings/layout.tsx is additionally a client layout, so all six /settings pages render client-side and lose the RSC-shell pattern
review_expiry: Convert each to a thin RSC shell exporting metadata and delegating to a sibling *Client.tsx, which is the pattern the rest of the app already follows
column23: app/verify/page.tsx was already 'use client' before this audit touched it; the pending-state fix did not introduce it

title: Unreachable carve-out in the middleware protected-route gate
root_cause: The gate reads `isProtectedRoute && !user && !publicRoutes.some(r => path.startsWith(r))`, but protectedRoutes (/home /calendar /feed /map /settings /manage-profiles) and publicRoutes (/terms /privacy /verify /onboarding) cannot both prefix-match one path, so the publicRoutes clause is always true when isProtectedRoute is true
reproduction: Static: the two prefix sets are disjoint, so no path can satisfy both predicates
production_impact: None - behaviour is correct today. It is misleading dead logic inside an auth gate, implying a public carve-out from protected routes that does not exist; a future edit to either array could make it silently meaningful
review_expiry: Remove the redundant clause or document why it is defensive
column23: Found while cross-checking protectedRoutes against the 23 page routes on disk. That cross-check also confirmed no page route is missing protection: /about, /contact and /offline are genuinely public, and /map/position-editor inherits protection from the /map prefix

title: Cross-user WebAuthn credential confusion — unauthenticated full account takeover
root_cause: The route derives IDENTITY from the challenge row (userId = storedChallenge.userId, set from a caller-supplied email at authenticate/options) but the VERIFYING PUBLIC KEY from getCredentialById(response.id), an unfiltered global lookup on credential_id with no user_id filter, and never reconciles the two
entrypoint: POST /api/webauthn/authenticate/verify (on the middleware public allowlist, so unauthenticated)
control: none — the ownership assertion was absent
sink: admin.generateLink + verifyOtp mints a session for the challenge's user
reproduction: Attacker registers a passkey on their own account; POSTs authenticate/options with the victim's email; signs that challenge with their OWN authenticator (allowCredentials is a client-side hint); verify checks the signature against the ATTACKER's public key and mints a VICTIM session cookie. Test reproduced it: 200 returned and verifyAuthenticationResponse was called
focused_verification: 3 new tests: cross-user credential -> 401 with generateLink/verifyOtp/updateCredentialCounter never called; check precedes the crypto; legitimate login still works
full_verification: 150 files / 1304 tests; typecheck exit 0; Lint OK
production_impact: Full account takeover of any user with a passkey, needing only their email address. No password, no MFA, no victim interaction
notes: Found independently by two lanes. @simplewebauthn cannot catch it (verifyAuthenticationResponse only asserts id === rawId). credential_id is UNIQUE so the attack is deterministic. The sibling register/verify has always had the equivalent check. NO test covered this route at all

title: Open redirect and session fixation on /auth/confirm
root_cause: `next.startsWith('/')` accepts a protocol-relative value; new URL('//evil.example', <route>) resolves to https://evil.example/. The redirect runs AFTER verifyOtp establishes a session
sink: NextResponse.redirect to an attacker origin with a live session
reproduction: Verified directly with new URL(). Attacker requests a reset for their OWN account, sends the victim a genuine syllabus-sync.app link with next=//evil.example and their own token_hash
focused_verification: 7 tests: 4 off-origin shapes rejected; recovery still reaches /reset-password?recovery=1; query strings preserved; failed token still errors
production_impact: Phishing from the product's own domain, plus the victim's browser left signed into the attacker's account
notes: isValidRedirect deliberately NOT reused: SAFE_REDIRECT_PATHS lacks '/reset-password', so it would have broken the one destination this route serves. Validated by resolved origin instead

title: Rate-limit store and weather provider fetches were unbounded
root_cause: UpstashRedisStore.command() and three weather fetches had no signal. next.revalidate does not bound a request, and open-next.config.ts has no incremental cache so it does not dedupe on Workers either
control: failClosed policy — unreachable on a hang
reproduction: Static: no signal on any of the four calls. checkRateLimit awaits the store BEFORE the handler runs
regression_test: none added (same class as the covered HIBP case)
focused_verification: 151 files / 1311 tests; both typechecks exit 0; Lint OK
production_impact: A stalled limiter store hangs every login, signup, password reset, MFA verify and passkey auth in the isolate — and failClosed never fires, because a hang throws nothing
notes: Found by the same outbound-host sweep that produced RTA-0006. 2s for the limiter, 2.5s for weather

title: audit_settings RLS gap and two absent definers — REPLAY-ONLY, not live
root_cause: audit_settings is the only one of 27 chain tables never given ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, and cleanup_old_audit_logs() (SECURITY DEFINER, reading its retention window from it) has no GRANT/REVOKE. Chained, that would let the anon key destroy the audit log
reproduction: LIVE CATALOGUE VERIFICATION (supabase db query --linked, read-only) shows audit_settings, cleanup_old_audit_logs and add_sample_class_times DO NOT EXIST in production, and NO public table lacks RLS (0 rows). The chain-derived P1 was therefore WRONG about production
focused_verification: 8 tests over the ordered chain; fail with `expected [ ''audit_settings'' ] to deeply equal []` when the migration is removed
full_verification: migration blocks now guarded; catalog expressions validated read-only against production
production_impact: NOT live. Real for any environment built from this chain — supabase db reset, staging, a DR rebuild — which is the M-09 replay class
notes: DOWNGRADED from P1 after live verification. Originally filed from the migration chain alone. Also caught a real bug in my own migration: the unguarded ALTER TABLE would have raised 42P01 and aborted the push against production — now guarded

title: Server-side and edge Sentry never initialize
root_cause: Next.js loads server instrumentation only from a root instrumentation.ts exporting register(). No such file exists, and @sentry/nextjs 10 auto-injects only the CLIENT config
reproduction: Verified: no instrumentation.ts or instrumentation-client.ts on disk; no .next/server/instrumentation.js in the build; @sentry/nextjs references sentry.client.config in webpack.js but has ZERO references to sentry.server.config; no onRequestError anywhere
production_impact: Every server-side error — API handlers, RSC renders, middleware, the scheduled cron path — is invisible in Sentry. SECURITY.md and CLAUDE.md both claim Sentry observability, so a silent 500 regression has no alerting path. It also makes BA-0018's awaited-init fix moot, since the module is never imported
review_expiry: Add a root instrumentation.ts exporting register() that imports ./sentry.server.config for NEXT_RUNTIME==='nodejs' and ./sentry.edge.config for 'edge', plus onRequestError; verify .next/server/instrumentation.js appears after build
column23: NOT fixed here: build-affecting and unverified against a Worker dry-run at the time of discovery

title: Reported: 11 UPDATE policies lack WITH CHECK, allowing row-ownership reassignment
root_cause: The premise misreads PostgreSQL policy semantics. Per CREATE POLICY: 'If no WITH CHECK expression is defined, then the USING expression will be used both to determine which rows are visible and which new rows will be allowed to be added.' So USING (auth.uid() = user_id) IS applied to the NEW row and reassignment is rejected
affected_files: units, class_times, deadlines, events, notifications, todos, profiles, user_preferences, schedules, webauthn_credentials, backup_codes
reproduction: I independently reproduced the 11-policy list by parsing the ordered chain, then rejected the conclusion on the documented semantics. The reporting lane's own root-cause sentence ('Postgres reuses USING for the new row when WITH CHECK is absent') contradicts its finding
production_impact: None. Reassignment is already blocked
review_expiry: Adding explicit WITH CHECK is still worthwhile hygiene — it survives a future loosening of USING and makes intent legible — but it is not a live vulnerability and must not be filed as one
column23: Recorded in full because the repo's OWN migration 20260730090000 (BA-0035) states the same incorrect rationale, so this misconception is already embedded in the codebase and will otherwise be re-derived. The genuine residual is the backup-code 'used' flag reset (RTA-0032), which changes no user_id and so passes both checks

title: A user can reset their own spent backup codes and replay them
root_cause: backup_codes single-use is enforced only by a client-writable `used` boolean. Resetting it changes no user_id, so both USING and the implied WITH CHECK pass. Separately, consumeBackupCode does not check the affected row count
entrypoint: PostgREST PATCH on an own row
reproduction: Static. This is the part of the reported finding that survives the RTA-0031 correction, because it does not attempt to change ownership
production_impact: LATENT: lib/security/two-factor-backup-codes.ts has no importer outside the security barrel, so no route mounts this flow today. Becomes live if the documented routes are ever wired up
review_expiry: WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id AND used = true) so the flag is one-way; add UNIQUE (user_id, code); make consumption an atomic claim checking the row count (same shape as the RTA-0004 fix)
column23: Also carries the RTA-0004 defect class — read-then-write with an unchecked row count

title: purge_deleted_records and refresh_analytics_views are anon-executable in production
root_cause: Both are SECURITY DEFINER with no ownership check and an unpinned search_path, and hold EXECUTE for BOTH anon and authenticated. 20260114013519 issued only REVOKE ... FROM PUBLIC, which BA-0032 already established does not remove Supabase's direct anon/authenticated grants
entrypoint: POST /rest/v1/rpc/purge_deleted_records and /rpc/refresh_analytics_views with the publishable anon key
sink: hard DELETE of every soft-deleted row for every user; three REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY full scans per call
reproduction: Verified live via information_schema.role_routine_grants: client_exec = anon,authenticated for both. Zero application callers — the only repository mentions are generated entries in lib/supabase/database.types.ts
focused_verification: catalog expressions validated read-only; both resolve to real production targets
production_impact: purge_deleted_records takes a caller-controlled window: a negative p_days_old moves the cutoff into the FUTURE and hard-deletes every soft-deleted row for every user, destroying the restore feature. refresh_analytics_views is unauthenticated I/O amplification against the database
notes: These are the genuinely LIVE half of what was filed as RTA-0029. Escaped the BA-0029/0031 sweeps because those grep for a BROKEN guard and these have none

title: Reported: log_audit has two overloads, so server-side audit writes fail silently
root_cause: Production holds only log_audit(text,text,uuid,jsonb,jsonb,text,jsonb,uuid,text,text) — the 10-arg form, SECURITY DEFINER with search_path=public. The 7-arg overload from 20260129000000 does not exist, so there is no ambiguity and logAuditServer resolves normally
reproduction: Verified live: select oid::regprocedure from pg_proc where proname='log_audit' returns exactly one row
production_impact: None in production. The chain WOULD create both on a fresh replay, so it remains an instance of the replay-divergence class
notes: The reporting lane flagged its own countervailing evidence (database.types.ts lists only the 10-arg form) and was right to; the live query settles it

title: pg_cron duplicates two Cloudflare crons at identical minutes — CONFIRMED LIVE
root_cause: pg_cron is installed and two jobs are ACTIVE at 0 3 * * * and 10 3 * * *, the exact expressions Cloudflare uses for /api/auth/email/cleanup and /api/auth/password/cleanup
